name: Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages (TESOL) Minor: Certification Track
description: The TESOL minor prepares students to (1) promote educational equity and the academic achievement of learners whose home language is not English; (2) deliver instruction in how to speak, read, write, listen, and communicate in English; and (3) support learners in their acquisition of content knowledge and academic language while they learn English. Students in the Education program must combine the TESOL minor with at least one of the following programs: elementary education (PK-3 or 3-6), or any of the following 5-9, 7-12, or PK-12 programs: English language arts, French, mathematics, science, social studies, Spanish, or special education. Secondary candidates should consider the English language arts major or minor. Students must complete Calvin's world language core. The program leads to the PK-12 English as a Second Language endorsement on the Michigan teaching certificate. Students who are not in the education program should complete the TESOL non-certification minor. Students in the education program complete one of the following degree options for teacher certification: Elementary education: PK-3, BA Elementary education: 3-6, BA Secondary education, BA Special Education K-12: Cognitive Impairment, BA

requirements.name: Program Requirements
requirements.description: Note: (1) The TESOL minor combines well with the Language Arts (ELEM) or English (SEC) majors because of the allowance of a two-course overlap. (2) Students must complete Calvin's foreign language core.
